metadata.name: codex-approval-watcher-service
metadata.description: Install and validate the persistent Codex ntfy approval watcher on a Gentoo/OpenRC host.

variables.name: repo_root
variables.description: Local checkout used to install the watcher service.

variables.name: ntfy_env_file
variables.description: Export file containing NTFY_URL and CODEX_NTFY_* variables.

stages.summary: Run the repo shell validation suite before changing host service state.
Install the OpenRC service, enable it in default runlevel, and restart it.
notes: This step is host-mutating and may trigger a sandbox approval dialog in Codex.
The installer enables the service with rc-update and restarts it with rc-service.

stages.summary: Confirm the OpenRC service is running.
artifacts: stdout or stderr includes status: started

stages.summary: Inspect the effective service configuration file.
